text: How the watcher does every effect once, for D-0069. An agent run's record is a ref, `refs/invariant/runs/<issue>/<step>`: `draft-<command>` for a draft, `build-<post>` for the build a ratification or a retry started. It's created atomically before the run starts, pointing at an empty commit, and moves to the run's result when the run finishes. A draft's result is its outcome as JSON. A build's is a commit holding its outcome, on top of the commit of its code, which any watcher can push. A run recorded with no result stopped partway. The factory says so, as a stuck draft or a stopped build, and a writer's `revise` or `retry` starts a new run. A merge is recorded as `merge-<pull request>-<head>` before it happens, holding what the protocol checked, so a watcher that finds the pull request merged at that head records the factory's merge, with its numbers. A pull request GitHub refused is opened again from the recorded result on the next poll, with no second agent run. The build's local done files are gone. A test stops the watcher before each of 20 effects, on the same machine and on another, and each time the issue merges with one post per command, one agent run per command or build, one pull request and one merge.
